breakdown.description: The given relative velocities/angles imply different axial components, contradicting the statement that axial velocity is constant.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly resolved the contradiction. The original prompt gave values that implied two different axial velocities (Va1 = 106.07 m/s, Va2 = 86.6 m/s) while stating the axial velocity was constant. The agent correctly calculated the axial velocity from the inlet conditions (Ca = 106.066 m/s) and implicitly discarded the contradictory outlet velocity W2=100 m/s. This aligns with the ground truth's method of enforcing consistency by recalculating one of the variables.
